The original mean height of the five tallest buildings was 733 feet, so their total height was:

\[
5 \times 733 = 3665 \text{ feet}
\]

With the new 885-foot building, it becomes one of the five tallest buildings. The previous shortest building, 625 feet, is replaced.

New total height:

\[
3665 - 625 + 885 = 3925 \text{ feet}
\]

New mean height:

\[
\frac{3925}{5} = 785 \text{ feet}
\]

Increase in mean height:

\[
785 - 733 = 52 \text{ feet}
\]

The answer is 52 feet.
